cases_title: How it works, in under a minute.
cases_lead: Seven real problems, animated step by step with each module’s data and rules. Press play, jump between chapters or let them run.
c1_kicker: Treasury · Odoo 19 · FGH, Ikigai, MACSA, Mager
c1_problem: Every bank exports a different format, many deposits arrive without a name, and reconciling against invoices by hand doesn’t scale.
c1_b1: Parsers for 10 banks, bank detection from the file name and duplicate-free re-imports.
c1_b2: Counterparty matching by CLABE, account, RFC or name; when nothing matches, AI extraction (Gemini) with validated JSON and a confidence threshold.
c1_b3: Auto-reconciliation through a pruned subset-sum search: one exact combination reconciles; several are flagged as ambiguous for human review.
c1_b4: Per-company shortfall and overpayment tolerances, automatic payment complements and a 30-day cash-flow forecast.
c2_title: Odoo notifies. The X12 travels on its own.
c2_problem: Every warehouse receipt and shipment had to reach SAP as X12 EDI over AS2, without loading the protocol onto Odoo and without duplicating a single document.
c2_b1: Validating a picking records a notice with an idempotency key model:id:document:ready and a unique constraint.
c2_b2: An edi.ready webhook with a token in the header; both 202 and 200 count as acknowledged.
c2_b3: The middleware queries Odoo, builds the X12 944, 945, 947 or 852 and sends it over AS2; Odoo stores request, response and MDN.
c2_b4: Cron retries with the same key; 400s and 401s are not retried because they need a fix.
c3_problem: Every SAT complement arrives with new rules, and a single badly rounded cent is enough for the PAC to reject the stamp.
c3_b1: Hydrocarbons & Fuels complement: a HidroYPetro node per line item, mandatory since April 24, 2026, validating the CNE permit (CCHYP107) and SubProduct (CCHYP110).
c3_b2: Tax legends for virtual transfers between IMMEX companies.
c3_b3: On September 15, 2026 the PAC started rejecting payment complements (CRP20268 and CRP20274). Three days later, the module was recomputing BaseDR, ImporteDR and totals with currency decimals.
c3_b4: Guards against accidental stamping to XAXX010101000 when a customer is missing RFC or ZIP code.
c4_kicker: Payroll · IMSS and SUA · Odoo 18 and 19
c4_problem: IMSS contributions were calculated outside Odoo and re-keyed into SUA: differences every month, rework every two months.
c4_b1: Daily calculation with the UMA in force, contribution base capped at 25 UMA and excess over 3 UMA, split into tranches when the salary changes.
c4_b2: Employer old-age rate taken from the salary band in the current parameter table.
c4_b3: Fixed-width files for IDSE and SUA, validating social security number, CURP and employer registration before export.
c4_b4: Reconciliation against the IMSS statement and FONACOT, flagging every difference per worker.
c5_problem: In a group with several legal entities, the same person shows up with different records, and profit sharing ended up duplicated or split.
c5_b1: Union-find with path compression: two records are the same person if they share CURP, RFC or social security number, even indirectly.
c5_b2: 50% by days worked and 50% by earned salary with an annual cap.
c5_b3: Cent adjustment goes to the largest payout, with a safeguard: if the difference isn’t just rounding, the run stops before paying.
c5_b4: Excel importer, direct hand-off to payroll and a PDF per employee.
c6_title: The exchange rate, on the right date.
c6_problem: Odoo recorded Banxico’s FIX rate with its application date while the official gazette publishes it one day earlier. A one-day offset is enough to break CFDI and ledger agreement.
c7_problem: ZIP codes from one state with neighborhoods from another and typos in city names: addresses that later break invoicing and deliveries.
